name: DeHashed
tagline: Search breached credentials and identity exposure across historical leak databases
description: DeHashed provides a breach-data search API for looking up emails, usernames, IPs, passwords, and other identity attributes in aggregated leak datasets. Developers use it for account-takeover risk checks, credential exposure monitoring, and security investigations. Authentication is typically API-key based; confirm current base URL, free-tier limits, and rate limits from official docs before production use.

auth.details: API key authentication (header or query per current docs); self-serve account required

use_cases: check if an email appears in known data breaches
look up username exposure across leak databases
assess credential reuse risk for a password hash or value
investigate IP or domain-related breach records for identity risk workflows
